PSSSB Clerk Accounts 2027 - Syllabus & Exam Pattern

I cleared the Punjab Police Sub Inspector exam with Rank 2 (713/800). Clerk (Accounts) is the one PSSSB clerk exam where a B.Com student starts ahead: three-quarters of the main paper is your own degree. This page collects what the official exam plans say.

The latest round is PSSSB Advertisement No. 12 of 2026 (published 18 September 2026, applications 25 September to 19 October 2026). It has 34 Clerk (Accounts) posts at Rs 19,900 - 25 in the Employment Generation, Skill Development and Training department and 9 in Excise and Taxation field offices. The written exam date is still awaited. Before that, the last separate round was Advt 19/2021, examined in December 2021 and again in November 2022.

Will there be posts in 2027?

Advt 12/2026 shows the demand is back: 34 Clerk (Accounts) posts in one advertisement. Note that eligibility differs by department - the Employment Generation posts ask for a graduate with Statistics, Mathematics or Accounts as a subject, while the Excise and Taxation posts ask for a commerce degree. Both need matric Punjabi and a 30 wpm typing test, and merit comes from Part B of the written exam. Whether more posts follow in 2027 depends on new demand, but anyone preparing for Advt 12/2026 is already on the right track.

Exam pattern (2022 official plan)

PartQuestionsMarks
Clerk (Accounts) subject syllabus9090
GK, English, Punjabi, logical reasoning and mental ability3030
Total120120
  • Time: 2 hours, MCQ on OMR sheet.
  • Negative marking: 1 mark per question, 1/4 mark cut for each wrong answer.
  • Since October 2022: every PSSSB exam opens with a qualifying matric-level Punjabi Part A (50% needed); merit comes only from the main paper.
  • After the written exam: a qualifying typing test (30 wpm, English and Punjabi) and counselling.

Subject syllabus

  1. Financial accounting - accounting standards (depreciation, inventories, revenue recognition, cash flow, EPS), share capital, bonus and rights shares, buy-back, company final accounts, amalgamation and reconstruction.
  2. Cost accounting - job, process and activity-based costing, CVP analysis, marginal costing for decisions, budgeting, standard costing and variances.
  3. Taxation - income tax heads (salary, house property, business, capital gains, other sources), set-off and carry forward, deductions; salient VAT and service tax provisions (revise GST, which replaced them, as well).
  4. Auditing - company audit, divisible profits and dividends, tax audit, audit of banks, insurance and NGOs.
  5. Financial management - ratios, fund flow and cash flow, capital budgeting, cost of capital, working capital.
  6. Financial markets and institutions - money and capital markets, banks and regulators.

How to prepare

  1. Solve the real papers. We have Clerk Accounts papers from 2021 and 2022 with official answer keys.
  2. Revise B.Com numericals fast. Ratios, depreciation and CVP questions must take under a minute each.
  3. Income tax changes every year. Read the current slabs and deductions, not your old textbook.
  4. Keep 30 GK marks safe. Punjab history, basic reasoning and grammar come from the common PSSSB syllabus.
  5. Learn Raavi typing. The typing test is qualifying, but it decides who actually gets the post.

Straight answers

Frequently asked questions

What is the PSSSB Clerk Accounts exam pattern?

In the 2022 exam plan - 120 MCQs, 120 marks, 2 hours. 90 questions from the accounts subject and 30 from GK, English, Punjabi and reasoning, with 1/4 mark cut for each wrong answer. Since October 2022 PSSSB adds a qualifying Punjabi Part A.

What subjects come in the Clerk Accounts paper?

Financial accounting, cost accounting, taxation (income tax, VAT and service tax provisions), auditing, financial management, and financial markets and institutions - roughly a B.Com syllabus.

Who can apply for PSSSB Clerk Accounts?

The post has been advertised for commerce graduates. The exact degree, percentage and computer-course condition are fixed in each advertisement, so check the new notification when it comes.

Is there a typing test for Clerk Accounts?

Yes. Like other PSSSB clerk posts, candidates who clear the written exam take a qualifying Punjabi and English typing test at 30 wpm.

Will Clerk Accounts posts come in 2027?

No 2027 notification yet, but PSSSB Advertisement No. 12 of 2026 (applications closed 19 October 2026) has 34 Clerk (Accounts) posts. Its exam is still awaited, and further posts in 2027-28 depend on new demand from departments.
